section.content: 本发明提供了一种水性粘结剂及其应用，所述水性粘结剂包括儿茶酚羧酸类化合物改性的壳聚糖，所述儿茶酚羧酸类化合物包括左旋多巴、α‑甲基多巴、屈昔多巴、3,4‑二氢咖啡酸、二羟基桂皮酸、二羟苯乙酸、原儿茶酸、3,4‑二氢扁桃酸或大黄酸中的任意一种或至少两种的组合。本发明所述水性粘结剂具有良好的力学性能和湿态粘接能力，在硅负极体积变化时，能发挥优异的粘结作用，不会使体系开裂而导致掉粉的问题，能显著提升硅碳体系锂离子电池的容量和循环性能。

The application provides an aqueous binder and application thereof, wherein the aqueous binder comprises chitosan modified by catechol carboxylic acid compounds, and the catechol carboxylic acid compounds comprise any one or a combination of at least two of levodopa, alpha-methyldopa, droxidopa, 3, 4-dihydrocaffeic acid, dihydroxycinnamic acid, dihydroxyphenylacetic acid, protocatechuic acid, 3, 4-dihydromandelic acid or rhein. The aqueous binder has good mechanical property and wet adhesion capability, can play an excellent role in adhesion when the volume of a silicon negative electrode is changed, can not cause the problem of powder falling caused by cracking of a system, and can remarkably improve the capacity and the cycle performance of a silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery.

Aqueous binder and application thereofTechnical Field

The application belongs to the technical field of batteries, and relates to an aqueous binder, in particular to an aqueous binder and application thereof.

Background

With the high-speed development of new energy automobiles, the existing commercial anode and cathode materials obviously cannot meet the requirement of lithium ion batteries on energy density, particularly, the actual specific capacity of a graphite anode material is close to the theoretical specific capacity, and a silicon anode material becomes the most promising anode material of the next-generation lithium ion battery due to the higher theoretical specific capacity (4200 mAh/g).

However, silicon has a great volume change during the lithium intercalation and deintercalation process, which seriously affects the service life of the battery. The commercial mixed system of CMC (sodium carboxymethyl cellulose) and SBR (styrene butadiene emulsion) and PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) are used as binders, and obviously cannot exert better bonding effect when the volume of a silicon negative electrode is changed.

Based on the above study, how to provide an aqueous binder, which can exert better binding effect when the volume of the silicon negative electrode changes, and remarkably improve the capacity and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery of the silicon negative electrode system, becomes the problem which needs to be solved urgently at present.

Disclosure of Invention

The application aims to provide an aqueous binder and application thereof, in particular to an aqueous binder for a silicon negative electrode and application thereof, wherein the aqueous binder is used in the silicon negative electrode, can solve the problem that the silicon negative electrode is cracked due to volume change in the process of lithium intercalation and deintercalation of silicon, and enables the silicon negative electrode to have excellent electrochemical performance in the circulating process.

In order to achieve the aim of the application, the application adopts the following technical scheme:

in a first aspect, the present application provides an aqueous binder comprising catechol carboxylic acid compound modified chitosan, the aqueous binder having the structural formula:

wherein X is determined by catechol carboxylic acid compound;

the structural general formula of the catechol carboxylic acid compound is as follows:

the catechol carboxylic acid compound comprises any one or at least two of levodopa, alpha-methyldopa, droxidopa, 3, 4-dihydro-caffeic acid, dihydroxycinnamic acid, dihydroxyphenylacetic acid, protocatechuic acid, 3, 4-dihydro-mandelic acid or rhein, and typical but non-limiting combinations comprise a combination of levodopa and alpha-methyldopa, a combination of droxidopa and 3, 4-dihydro-caffeic acid, a combination of levodopa and droxidopa, or a combination of protocatechuic acid and 3, 4-dihydro-mandelic acid.

When the catechol carboxylic acid compound is a combination of two substances, the molar ratio of any two catechol carboxylic acid compounds is 1 (0.5 to 2.5), for example, 1:0.5, 1:1, 1:1.5, 1:2 or 1:2.5, but the catechol carboxylic acid compounds are not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values in the numerical range are equally applicable.

Compared with the traditional adhesive, the aqueous adhesive is the catechol carboxylic acid compound modified chitosan, has better adhesive strength, can play an excellent adhesive role when the volume of the system is changed, can not crack the system to cause the problem of powder falling, can also have good adhesive force in liquid, and can keep good adhesive stability of the negative electrode in electrolyte.

Preferably, the catechol carboxylic acid comprises any one or a combination of at least two of levodopa, alpha-methyldopa or dihydroxycinnamic acid, typically but not limited to a combination of levodopa and alpha-methyldopa, or a combination of dihydroxycinnamic acid and alpha-methyldopa, preferably dihydroxycinnamic acid.

Preferably, the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 100000 to 1000000, for example 100000, 500000 or 1000000, but not limited to the values listed, other values not listed in the range of values are equally applicable, preferably 200000 to 500000.

The preparation method of the water-based adhesive comprises the following steps:

and mixing catechol carboxylic acid compound with chitosan, reacting, dialyzing, concentrating and drying to obtain the aqueous binder.

Preferably, the mixing comprises dissolving catechol carboxylic acid compound in hydrochloric acid solution, and mixing chitosan and catalyst into the dispersion.

Preferably, the mass ratio of chitosan to catechol carboxylic acid compound is 1 (0.5 to 1.5), for example, it may be 1:0.5, 1:1 or 1:1.5, but not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the mass fraction of the hydrochloric acid solution is 1wt% to 5wt%, for example, 1wt%, 2wt%, 3wt%, 4wt% or 5wt%, but is not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the catechol carboxylic acid compound is present in an amount of 4wt% to 6wt%, based on the mass of the dispersion, for example 4wt%, 5wt% or 6wt%, but not limited to the values recited, other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the mass ratio of catechol carboxylic acid compound to catalyst is 1 (0.1 to 0.3), for example, 1:0.1, 1:0.2 or 1:0.3, but not limited to the recited values, other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the catalyst comprises 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide.

Preferably, the temperature of the mixing is from 20 ℃ to 30 ℃, for example, 20 ℃, 25 ℃ or 30 ℃, but is not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the mixing time is 12h to 24h, for example, 12h, 16h, 18h, 20h, 22h or 24h, but not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the dialysis is performed for a period of 3 days to 7 days, for example, 3 days, 5 days or 7 days, but is not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the concentration mode comprises rotary evaporation concentration.

In a second aspect, the present application provides a negative electrode comprising an aqueous binder according to the first aspect.

When the aqueous binder is used as the binder of the silicon negative electrode, the volume of silicon can change in the lithium intercalation and deintercalation process in the battery cycle process, and the aqueous binder has excellent mechanical property and wet adhesion capability, so that the problem of cracking of the silicon negative electrode caused by the volume change can be avoided, and the capacity and cycle performance of the battery are improved.

Preferably, the active material layer of the negative electrode includes 5 parts to 15 parts of the aqueous binder in terms of parts by weight, and may be, for example, 5 parts, 10 parts, or 15 parts, but is not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the active material layer of the negative electrode further includes 80 parts to 90 parts of a silicon-based material, for example, 80 parts, 85 parts, or 90 parts, by weight, but not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the silicon-based material includes any one of elemental silicon, a silicon oxygen compound, or a silicon carbon material.

Preferably, the active material layer of the negative electrode further includes 5 parts to 10 parts of a conductive agent, for example, 5 parts, 8 parts or 10 parts, by weight, but not limited to the recited values, and other non-recited values within the range of values are equally applicable.

Preferably, the combination of any one or at least two of acetylene black, conductive carbon black or carbon nanotubes, typically but not limited to, comprises a combination of acetylene black and conductive carbon black, or a combination of acetylene black and carbon nanotubes.

In a third aspect, the present application provides an electrochemical device comprising a negative electrode as described in the second aspect.

Preferably, the electrochemical device comprises a lithium ion battery.

In a fourth aspect, the present application provides an electronic device comprising an electrochemical apparatus according to the third aspect.

Compared with the prior art, the application has the following beneficial effects:

according to the application, the catechol carboxylic acid compound is adopted to modify chitosan to obtain the aqueous binder, so that the aqueous binder has good mechanical property and wet adhesion capability, and can play an excellent role in adhesion when the volume of a silicon negative electrode is changed when being used for the silicon negative electrode binder, so that the silicon negative electrode is not cracked and is subjected to powder dropping, and meanwhile, the capacity and the cycle performance of a silicon negative electrode lithium ion battery can be improved.

Detailed Description

The technical scheme of the application is further described by the following specific embodiments. It will be apparent to those skilled in the art that the examples are merely to aid in understanding the application and are not to be construed as a specific limitation thereof.

Example 1

The embodiment provides an aqueous binder, wherein the aqueous binder is levodopa-modified chitosan, and the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 500000;

the preparation method of the aqueous binder comprises the following steps:

dissolving levodopa in a hydrochloric acid solution with the mass fraction of 1wt%, mixing chitosan and a catalyst, mixing the obtained dispersion liquid at 25 ℃ for 12 hours, dialyzing for 3 days, and concentrating by rotary evaporation and drying to obtain the water-based binder;

the catalyst is 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide;

the content of levodopa is 5wt% based on the mass of the dispersion; the mass ratio of the chitosan to the levodopa is 1:1.5; the mass ratio of the levodopa to the catalyst is 1:0.2.

Example 2

The embodiment provides an aqueous binder, wherein the aqueous binder is levodopa-modified chitosan, and the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 100000;

the preparation method of the aqueous binder comprises the following steps:

dissolving levodopa in 3wt% hydrochloric acid solution, mixing chitosan and catalyst, mixing the obtained dispersion at 30deg.C for 16h, dialyzing for 5 days, concentrating by rotary evaporation, and oven drying to obtain the aqueous binder;

the catalyst is 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide;

the content of levodopa is 4wt% based on the mass of the dispersion; the mass ratio of the chitosan to the levodopa is 1:0.5; the mass ratio of the levodopa to the catalyst is 1:0.1.

Example 3

The embodiment provides an aqueous binder, wherein the aqueous binder is levodopa-modified chitosan, and the weight average molecular weight of the aqueous binder is 600000;

the preparation method of the aqueous binder comprises the following steps:

dissolving levodopa in a hydrochloric acid solution with the mass fraction of 4wt%, mixing chitosan and a catalyst, mixing the obtained dispersion liquid at 20 ℃ for 24 hours, dialyzing for 4 days, performing rotary evaporation concentration and drying to obtain the aqueous binder;

the catalyst is 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide;

the content of levodopa is 6wt% based on the mass of the dispersion; the mass ratio of the chitosan to the levodopa is 1:0.8; the mass ratio of the levodopa to the catalyst is 1:0.3.

Example 4 and example 5 the procedure was the same as in example 1, except that the types of catechol carboxylic acid compounds were changed as shown in Table 2, and the preparation methods were changed accordingly.

Example 6 and example 7 the same as in example 1, except that the mass ratio of chitosan to levodopa was changed as shown in table 3.

Comparative example 1 provides a binder which is a commercially available PAA (polyacrylic acid).

Comparative example 2 provides a binder that is commercially available PVDF (HSV 900).

Comparative example 3 provides a binder which is phenylacetic acid modified chitosan, the binder having a weight average molecular weight of 500000;

the preparation method of the binder was the same as in example 1 except that the raw material adaptability was changed.

Application examples 1 to 7 provide a negative electrode, wherein the active material layer of the negative electrode comprises 10 parts of acetylene black, 80 parts of silicon carbon material and 10 parts of aqueous binder, and the aqueous binder is dissolved in water to obtain 5wt% of aqueous binder solution for use; the aqueous binders in application examples 1 to 7 correspond to the aqueous binders provided in examples 1 to 7, respectively.

Application example 8 provides a negative electrode, wherein the active material layer of the negative electrode comprises 5 parts by weight of carbon nanotubes, 90 parts by weight of silicon carbon material, and 5 parts by weight of the aqueous binder of example 1; the aqueous binder was dissolved in water to give a 5wt% aqueous binder solution for use.

Application example 9 provides a negative electrode, the active material layer of which comprises 5 parts of acetylene black, 80 parts of silicon carbon material and 15 parts of the aqueous binder of example 1 in parts by weight; the aqueous binder was dissolved in water to give a 5wt% aqueous binder solution for use.

Application examples 10 to 11 provided a negative electrode, and the rest was the same as application example 1 except that the parts of the aqueous binder were changed, and the acetylene black and the silicon carbon material were changed accordingly so that the total of the parts by weight was 100 parts as shown in table 4.

Comparative application examples 1 to 3 provide a negative electrode whose active material layer comprises, in parts by weight, 10 parts of acetylene black, 80 parts of a silicon carbon material, and 10 parts of an aqueous binder dissolved in water to obtain a binder solution of 5wt% for use, respectively; the aqueous binders in comparative application examples 1 to 3 correspond to the aqueous binders provided in comparative examples 1 to 3, respectively.

Performance test:

the negative electrode, the positive electrode, the diaphragm and the electrolyte provided by the application examples and the comparative application examples are assembled into a soft-package lithium ion battery according to a general process for preparing the soft-package lithium ion battery; the positive electrode is obtained by coating and drying positive electrode slurry on a copper foil, wherein the positive electrode slurry comprises the following components in percentage by mass of 95:3:2:40LNCM (LiNi) 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 ) Acetylene black, polyvinylidene fluoride and N-methylpyrrolidone; the membrane adopts a polypropylene microporous membrane (Celgard-2400); the electrolyte adopts LiPF of 1mol/L 6 Ec+dmc+emc (EC is ethylene carbonate, EMC is methyl ethyl carbonate, DMC is dimethyl carbonate, the volume ratio of EC, DMC and EMC is 1:1:1).

And (3) testing the cycle performance of the assembled soft package lithium ion battery: and (3) adopting a Cheng Hong electric appliance Co., ltd battery performance test system (BTS 05/10C 8D-HP), dividing the discharge capacity of the soft package lithium ion battery in 1C/1C cycle by the 50 th discharge capacity divided by the first cycle discharge capacity to obtain the capacity retention rate after 50 cycles.

Negative electrode peel strength test: taking a rolled negative plate, and cutting; firstly, sticking a piece of double-sided tape (the length is longer than the test length of the sample and the same width as the pole piece) on the center of the steel plate, smoothing the double-sided tape forcibly to ensure that the double-sided tape is tightly stuck on the center of the steel plate, uncovering the double-sided tape, sticking the pole piece on the adhesive tape, arranging an upper clip and a lower clip on a tension machine, inserting the steel plate stuck with the fixed pole piece into the lower clip, and vertically fixing the steel plate; and inserting the non-glued pole piece into the upper clamp for internal fixation, enabling the pole piece attached to the gummed paper and the pole piece fixed by the upper clamp to form 180 degrees, and after a test sample is fixed, starting the test to obtain the peeling strength.

From tables 1 to 5, the following points can be seen:

(1) The application examples 1 to 11 show that the aqueous binder has good bonding strength, can improve the capacity and the cycle performance of a silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery, and solves the problem of the reduction of the cycle performance caused by the volume expansion cracking of a silicon negative electrode in the cycle process.

(2) As is clear from application examples 1 and 6 to 7, when the amount of levodopa is too small, the effect of the aqueous binder is reduced as compared with application example 1, and the cycle performance of the obtained silicon carbon system lithium ion battery is reduced, and when the amount of levodopa is too large, the cycle performance of the silicon carbon system lithium ion battery is not significantly improved.

(3) As is clear from application example 1 and application examples 8 to 11, when the amount of the aqueous binder added to the silicon negative electrode is too small, the cycle performance of the obtained silicon carbon system lithium ion battery is lowered as compared with application example 1, and when the amount of the aqueous binder added to the silicon negative electrode is increased in order, the cycle performance of the obtained silicon carbon system lithium ion battery is improved, but when the amount is increased to 18 parts out of the preferable range, the cycle performance is not improved as compared with 15 parts; therefore, on the premise of saving resources, the water-based adhesive is added with a proper amount, so that the water-based adhesive can be matched with the conductive agent and the silicon-carbon material to play an optimal role.

(4) As can be seen from application example 1, comparative application example 1 and comparative application example 2, compared with the silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery adopting the conventional binder, the silicon-carbon system lithium ion battery adopting the aqueous binder has obviously improved cycle performance; as is clear from application example 1 and comparative application example 3, the aqueous binder was modified chitosan, but the catechol carboxylic acid compound of the present application was not used for modification, and the performance was significantly deteriorated as compared with application example 1.

In summary, the application provides an aqueous binder and application thereof, wherein the aqueous binder is obtained by modifying chitosan with catechol carboxylic acid compounds, has good mechanical properties and wet adhesion capacity, can play an excellent role in adhesion when the volume of a silicon negative electrode is changed, can not crack a system to cause the problem of powder falling, and can remarkably improve the cycle performance of the silicon carbon system lithium ion battery.

The foregoing is merely illustrative of the present application, and the present application is not limited thereto, and it should be apparent to those skilled in the art that any changes or substitutions that fall within the technical scope of the present application disclosed herein are within the scope of the present application.
